abstract: An anamorphic lens known as “Scanoscope” has been developed for use in motion pictures and television. The optical design is described, showing how the aberrations are controlled over a field angle of 80° or more. A unique coupling arrangement allows this lens to be used interchangeably with camera lenses of different focal length in a unit focus arrangement. Application of this system to the Mitchell NC and BNC cameras is described.
